alternative_interpretations: This is a casual snapshot capturing a moment of shared attention without intentional symbolic meaning.
limitations: No verbal or contextual cues confirm intentional philosophical framing; interpretation relies solely on compositional arrangement.

limitations: Stillness may be functional (for photography) rather than existential.
